intro: First Five uses native placement rewards on Twitch and Kick, plus Viewer Foundation points and one command on YouTube and TikTok.

sections.title: 1. Turn on First Five
sections.description: Enable the add-on after the platform-specific inputs below are ready.

sections.title: 2. Twitch rewards
sections.description: Paste five ordered Twitch reward IDs from first through fifth place.
sections.notice: Create five Twitch rewards named First Five: Claim 1st Place through First Five: Claim 5th Place. Recommended cost: 100 each; color: #2DB7A3; description: 'Claim this First Five placement for the current stream.' Keep viewer input off and Skip Reward Queue disabled. Twitch can then enable the next reward, rename claimed rewards, and refund invalid claims.

sections.title: 3. Kick, YouTube, and TikTok
sections.description: Paste five ordered Kick reward IDs. YouTube and TikTok use the command and Viewer Foundation points instead.
sections.notice: Create the same five Kick rewards at 100 points each, color #2DB7A3, with viewer input off. Kick redemptions are accepted natively, but Streamer.bot documents no Kick sequence, title, enable, disable, or refund methods; only the expected next position is accepted and rejected Kick points cannot be returned.

sections.title: 4. Reward titles
sections.description: Set the available title for each placement and the title shown after a viewer claims it.

sections.title: 5. Platform chat messages
sections.description: Successful claims can be announced. Repeat-claim notices are off by default to prevent chat spam.

sections.title: 6. Monthly leaderboard
sections.description: The stream placements reset each stream. Weighted scores reset on the first event of a new local-calendar month.
sections.notice: Each platform has its own five-place board. Different platforms wait in a bounded display queue; repeated claims from the visible platform update that board without adding another card.

sections.title: Privacy and storage
sections.description: First Five stores platform-qualified stable user IDs, current display names, placement counts, and compact timestamps in its private atomic state. It stores no chat text, tokens, SlothCoins, or point balances.
sections.notice: Import the separate First Five Streamer.bot package. Keep Controller triggerless, approve it for this add-on, and optionally attach Reset to a deck button. Keep Skip Reward Queue disabled on Twitch. Kick cannot automatically sequence, rename, disable, or refund rewards, so create all five carefully and expect invalid Kick claims to remain spent. Trigger tests and simulated events never change live rewards.
